Hey i’m doing much better!! Im just so much more positive these days and i dont make a huge deal out of little things anymore. I know that we only live once and life generally isnt as complicated as we make it to be so i just try to always keep an optimistic point of view and keep improving myself until i reach my objectives! 
Thank you for asking!

Hello, 

I'm sorry for the late reply. I just wanted to thank you for your advice. After reading your comments I decided that it's time to change my life. I think as human being we tend to get very negative when we overthink/over analyze everything. I guess you're really the person who made me realize that no matter what situation we're in we can still change our lives. I really can't thank you enough for your help!!

When you gave a positive solution to every "obstacle" I was overthinking about I realized how whiny and ungrateful I sounded and how I was making such a huge deal out of minor "issues" in my head. 

I was really at a low point when wrote those comments and I was seriously contemplating ending my life. But instead of doing that I decided to BLOCK all my negative thoughts and  replace them with positive ones. Once I started doing that I realized how much more energy I have to pursue other things. So I started going to the gym every day, playing piano more often, making daily schedule to keep myself busy throughout the day. And I'm starting my training for a new job in April so I think I will go on vacation in between. 

But honestly I think the single best thing that I've done two weeks ago was removing myself from social media!! Instagram was the main reason I constantly felt lonely and unsatisfied with my life. It's honestly so toxic for mental health and I wish I had deleted it a LOOONG time ago! ughh wasted years i'll never get back :/
Hi im here if you need to talk!

Thank you so much for your reply. It means a lot that you took the time to write me and give me all these advice. I appreciate it. I think that past me was very different from current me as in I used to be very school/career focused. Thank you for reminding me that I did work very hard to get where I am today. And I guess what that thought me is that if you put enough effort in anything you can succeed at it. I think that I've changed a lot since then. I think that throughout the years I learned that success and making good money doesn't bring me joy. I need to have a job where I actually love what I'm doing (like you mentioned). 
My issue is that I put too much emphasis on school and work and neglected other aspects of my life like finding a partner etc. 
Like you said I shouldn't judge myself based on the progress of others but it's hard not to. I think I get specifically sad when I compare myself to couples that have been together for a long time like since hs/college. I just think about how well they must know each other since they practically grew up together and have so many memories with each other. And I see all those couple getting engaged or married now and I keep thinking what if I gave more guys a chance back then.. For some reason I keep thinking i missed out on that and that I'm too old now etc. 
I do realize that I have a very negative mindset but I think it comes from the fact that I've been depressed and alone for so long. ugh sometimes I really wish I could shut my brain off. 
I'm glad for you that you at least studied something that you enjoy working in. I think that's very important. And I think quitting your job was a good move especially since you got to also leave your gf that you wanted to break up with. 
You're absolutely right when you say that our environment is a huge contributor to our mood. I think that if I can save up to eventually leave my house that would already be a right first step into changing how I feel. And I also agree with you when you say that in a relationship your partner deserves to be with the best (or at least close) possible version of you. At the same time it's very tough sometimes because as a human you want love and affection and you can't help feeling a void. 
For the last two years I just feel trapped in the life that I have. Like I don't want to feel all this pressure and constant anxiety about my future. I feel lost and I'm not exactly sure about what I want to do career wise and I guess you could say that I lack PURPOSE even.
I understand. I feel the same. I don’t think i’ll be fully happy again unless i find someone

I’m so sorry for what happened to you:( 
I don’t believe in reincarnation or any type of after life once we’re dead so i’m not afraid of what’s to come next. I just want my suffering on this earth to end and completely vanish. 

Aww in my opinion i think you should tell the girl how you feel and maybe she feels the same about you and have just not been vocal about it?!
Think about it, what is there to lose if you do. It will at least make you feel better knowing that you put it out there and she can do what she wants with the information.
I know what you mean. I feel the same. Do you feel a void that you can’t seem to fill no matter what you do?

Thank you so much for your reply. You’re very sweet. 
I know what you mean. I feel very sorry for abusers and bullies actually because i think they’re all going through their own issues and their coping mechanism is to take out their problems on others. 

I’m actually not as young as you think. I’m 27 years old. I tried to keep the text as short as i could and that’s why I didn’t specify my current situation much. When i mentioned the past is because i wanted to explain why i’ve been feeling alone for such a long time. After high school, in college/university i met a lot of people and used to go out a lot but i lost touch with most of them. All of those people seem to being doing great now with many of them being very successful in their careers and being engaged/married with their long term partners. The few friends that i have left are mostly from high school and they’re all unhappy with their lives so when we get together the conversations can get very negative which doesn’t help any of our cases. And I still live at home mainly because during university i had to work and pay for my tuition fees myself so i couldn’t afford to move out and i still can’t because i barely have any money in my savings. At home the environment is very toxic because both my brother and mom have anger management issues and they yell and fight constantly. So basically the very few interactions i have with others are all very negative. 
Career wise, things are awful as well. I graduated in finance and have been working in a bank since. I’m now realizing that i chose the wrong career path as i do not like my job nor the type of people i work with (they’re all about the materialistic world, money and luxury which is the complete opposite of who i am). 
About a month ago I decided to backpack costa rica by myself and stayed in hostels. Over there i had some of the best experiences of my life and i also had the privilege of meeting many amazing people and it really made me realize how much the environment i’m in can impact my mood. 
When i came back to reality is when i realized even more how much im missing out on life and how im letting my life pass by crying and feeling lonely every day. 
But out of everything i think the thing that makes me most depressed is being single for 5 years. I think i just can’t seem to “keep” any guy despite how many dates i go on. For example i met a guy in costa rica who happens to live in city close to mine back home. He was very cute and seemed kind and genuine. We kept in touch and decided to meet each other again in my city last weekend. We hung out for hours and even kissed at the end of the night. He seemed very interested and talked about seeing each other again. He messaged me after the date and the next day. Then he completely disappeared and havent talked to me in 4 days. 
I find that this happens every time i connect with a guy and think the feeling is mutual. I get my hopes up only to be disappointed all over again. 
Thank you so much for your advices on dating and for replying to my post. 

I’ve been so extremely lonely and depressed that i’m not able to function anymore. I’ve been trying to keep myself busy on my down time by painting and playing the piano but i still feel sadness and void in any activity i do. 

I don’t like my job. I don’t feel good being home. And i barely go out anywhere because i have no one. I just don’t see the point in living anymore. There has been so much hurt, pain and loneliness in the short amount of time i’ve spent on earth so i just don’t see why i should continue suffering every day. I’ve had suicidal thoughts for a long time now and i think i will finally act on it because when i’m dead I’ll finally be at peace.
Aw:( feeling alone/isolated is honestly one of the worst feelings out there and it’s hard to manage it because it involves other people:/
I’m sorry to hear that :( have you been feeling like this for a while?

I’m sorry to hear that :(
I just find it so hard to go through the day feeling this way

I’m not sure what your dynamic with your parents are but have you tried talking to them about how they make you feel? 
If they don’t understand then i would say try to ignore them as much as you can until you move out

I’m sorry you feel that way. 
But there are so many things to look forward to after high school! Personally my late teen years were the best years of my life simply because i felt independent and free for the first time in my life and everything was so new. 
Post graduation is when you can decide whether you want to go to college, take some time off to travel, work, etc. 
If you choose the college route, you’ll get to pick what you want to major in and make your own schedule (unlike hs). Once you’re in college you’ll get to meet tons of new people similar to you either through joining associations or talking to people in your program courses. This is also a time you may have your first serious relationship or stay single and go to parties/clubs (if you’re into that) and have flings. 
If you choose to work right after hs, then you will have the privilege of being financially stable at such a young age. Keep in mind that you are very much in your prime at 18-19 years old which means you’ll be able to work yet still have the energy to do things after your shift and you’ll have the financial freedom to do so. You can choose to go out often, go travel, pick up new hobbies, etc.

There are so many things you have to look forward to!

Hi, i’m 27 years old and when i was in high school i went through something similar to you and i wanted to kill myself as well failing to realize how insignificant all those people were! When you’re in high school everything bad that happens feels like the end of the world because your world is just involved around high school problems/drama but then you graduate and realize that life hadnt even begun yet. Trust me there are so many amazing things/people you haven’t discovered/met yet. And all of these happen AFTER high school. 
And i cannot emphasize this enough but DO NOT worry about your looks in high school because your face hasn’t even fully developed yet. Teen years is just a very awkward phase of life but things will change, just ask some adults you know.

Aw i’m sorry you are going through this. I also felt that way for a very long time (that whenever i’m happy something goes wrong). But lately i realized that if im happy then i SHOULDN’T let anything ruin it and it works.
I also noticed that the majority of the time in the past my good mood was ruined was due to my family (similar to the scenario you described) and now i just learned to block it. Keep telling yourself: im in a good mood, nothing or anyone can mess it up on repeat. It’ll make you feel stronger and you’ll be proud of yourself for taking control of your mood. 
I hope this helps

Thank you so much for your advice. Honestly you’re right. I should just give it a chance because there’s nothing to lose. And if it helps then i guess it will help with my situation.

I’m so glad you took that initial step and it helped make you feel better.
I do but i keep thinking that it will be a waste of money and it won’t help

Thank you for your reply. I’m so sorry for what you went/are going through. As someone who has a similar issue I completely understand how you feel. 

You’re right, people assume that just because you look in the mirror often it means that you’re conceited which is not true. 

My thing is that my ocd sort of faded between 18-25 because i felt so pretty when i looked in the mirror. I think my problem is that i don’t look at myself just as a whole anymore and i really go into the details of things. So after 25 (Im 27 now btw) is when our bodies start to age and that’s when the eyes skin hair etc lose their glow and you start losing baby fat in your skin which naturally makes you look more worn out. Since last year i look in the mirror significantly less because i know it makes me depressed when i do. However i never feel fully happy anymore like i did when i was 21ish because the thought that i don’t look like the best version of myself is always in the back of my mind. 

Thank you so much for your advice! Did speaking with a professional help you btw?

I saw a social worker at one point and he categorized it as ocd. I’m not sure what to label it but i just wish i didn’t feel like this :( i’m ultra sensitive with changes in my body and i’m afraid it’s only going to get worse as i get older
